fusions.name: Cold Snap
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of cold ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and stunning it for 1 second. Each hit has a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Heat-Drunk Jab
fusions.desc: A thrown stinger that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range. It has a 35% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds up to 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Basking
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds. Stingers fight beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Left Behind
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds, and decoy stingers fight beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
